sources.title: samsonn/HuggingFaceDownloader · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Hugging Face Downloader Portable Hugging Face Downloader Portable is a free, self-contained Windows application for downloading models, datasets, and other files from Hugging Face repositories. Built with C# and WPF, it provides a graphical interface for browsing repository files, selecting individual files, and managing downloads without using the command line.
